classes.name: manifest
classes.reason: Each round every rank is held at barrier.wait() and then reads the same shared class_a file m%d for that round via _read_staged, so all ranks are blocked on that one file, and each rank touches a given round's file exactly once.

classes.name: shard
classes.reason: After the post-class_a barrier each rank synchronously _read()s its own r%d/s%d class_b files while other ranks do their own reads, and the per-rank file is re-read in each of the 200 rounds.

classes.name: sidecar
classes.reason: Each rank blocks on _read() of its private class_cs/r%d/s%d files in the per-round loop with no barrier between ranks' private reads, so the same file is read once per round for 200 rounds.
